Other tales explain taro terraces and water channels as his digging.

sections.title: Symbols and attributes
sections.text: A pig head or whole hog form, tusks, coarse bristles and great strength identify him, along with taro patches, wetlands and rain. Hawaiian carving and barkcloth patterns set human and animal shapes side by side, though details differ noticeably from island to island.

sections.title: Tradition and context
sections.text: These are Native Hawaiian oral traditions written down in the nineteenth century by Hawaiian scholars and recorders, and some layers belong only to particular families or communities. His image persists in hula and land struggles today. Citations should name island and version rather than merging them.

figures.name: 西娜
figures.title: 玻利尼西亚传统中的西娜

sections.title: 身份与来历
sections.text: 西娜是玻利尼西亚广泛流传的女性人物之名，萨摩亚、汤加、纽埃与毛利传统中都出现同名或近名的形象，含义与故事却并不同一。萨摩亚的传说讲述她与一条鳗鱼之间的交往，这则故事与椰子的起源相连，是当地最知名的叙述之一。

sections.title: 主要叙事
sections.text: 萨摩亚版本多讲：鳗鱼为西娜所爱或所惧，被村人杀死后嘱其将头埋下，由此长出椰树，树冠的纤维与果实被视为其形态的延续。另有以她为月神或女神者，说她居于月亮的背面，与潮汐和女性技艺相关；各岛谱系不同。

sections.title: 象征与辨识
sections.text: 辨识特征是椰树、鳗鱼或海蛇、月光与花饰。萨摩亚的椰子传说常在影像与舞蹈中以此为题；在毛利传统中，同源的名字更多与月、女性工艺及潮汐相连，形象与萨摩亚的西娜并不同一，不应按字形直接等同。

sections.title: 流传与文化语境
sections.text: 这些名字的相似反映出玻利尼西亚诸岛共同的南岛语渊源与长期的航海往来，但各社群对人物的理解自有脉络，需按岛屿与家族分别对待。传教士记录以及夏威夷、萨摩亚学者整理的口述文本，构成今日研究的主要依据；通俗读物常简化其差异。

en.name: Sina
en.title: A Polynesian woman of many versions

sections.title: Identity and origins
sections.text: Sina is a widely shared Polynesian name, appearing in Samoan, Tongan, Niuean and Maori traditions with related names but unlike stories. The Samoan tale of her dealings with an eel is the best known, since it explains the origin of the coconut and is told throughout the islands.

sections.title: Key narratives
sections.text: In Samoan versions the eel, loved or feared by Sina, is killed by villagers and asks that its head be buried, from which the coconut palm grows, its husk and fruit continuing its form. Other accounts make her a moon deity living on the moon’s far side, tied to tides and women’s crafts.

sections.title: Symbols and attributes
sections.text: Coconut palms, eels or sea snakes, moonlight and flower ornaments identify her. Samoan dance and film often take the coconut story as subject; in Maori tradition the cognate name belongs more to the moon, women’s weaving and tides, a distinct figure rather than the same person.

sections.title: Tradition and context
sections.text: The similar names reflect shared Austronesian roots and centuries of Polynesian voyaging, yet each community holds its own understanding, best treated island by island and family by family. Missionary records and texts compiled by Hawaiian and Samoan scholars are the main sources, while popular books flatten the differences.

figures.name: 天空鸸鹋
figures.title: 银河暗带中的鸸鹋身影

sections.title: 身份与来历
sections.text: 天空鸸鹋不是单一的神话人物，而是澳大利亚部分原住民族在夜空暗带中辨认出的鸸鹋形象，其轮廓由银河的尘埃暗带构成，头在南十字附近，身在银河之中。这一讲法由特定地区的原住民族公开讲述，并不具有全澳通用的地位。

sections.title: 主要叙事
sections.text: 公开流传的版本中，鸸鹋的形影与季节、蛋巢和泉水的出现相关：它在夜空中出现的时段指示何时寻蛋、何时雨水将至。相关叙述常以鸸鹋的坐姿或张开的身影描画暗带轮廓，并与邻近的星座、动物故事一并讲述。

sections.title: 象征与辨识
sections.text: 辨认方法是观察银河的暗尘带：南十字附近的头部、颈部的暗隙与银河中心的躯体。它属“暗云星座”一类，与以亮星连线的星座不同；不同语言群体对其命名、分段与解释各异，图形并非全澳统一的图案。

sections.title: 流传与文化语境
sections.text: 相关故事与知识由特定民族持有，如维多利亚西北部的布隆人，以及中部与北部的若干语族，各地讲述者决定何者可以外传。近年天文教育与博物馆展示多引用这一天文知识，引用时须标明来源民族，并避免使用受限制的细节。

en.name: Sky Emu
en.title: The emu shaped by the Milky Way’s dark lanes

sections.title: Identity and origins
sections.text: The Sky Emu is not a single mythic person but an emu recognised in the dark lanes of the Milky Way by particular Aboriginal peoples, its head near the Southern Cross and body within the galactic band. Such knowledge is told publicly by specific groups and is not pan-Australian.

sections.title: Key narratives
sections.text: In published versions the emu’s position marks seasons, nests and water: when it stands in the sky tells people when to seek eggs or expect rain. Narrators trace the dark shape as a sitting or open-winged bird and tell it alongside neighbouring star stories and animal narratives.

sections.title: Symbols and attributes
sections.text: Look for the dust lanes: the head near the Southern Cross, the dark gap of the neck, the body toward the galactic centre. It belongs with “dark constellations” rather than star-linked figures. Different language groups name and divide it differently, so no single design is universal.

sections.title: Tradition and context
sections.text: The stories are held by particular nations, such as the Boorong of north-western Victoria and various central and northern language groups, and each determines what may be shared. Astronomy education and museums now cite this knowledge, and should name its source peoples and avoid restricted detail.

figures.name: 凯霍斯鲁
figures.title: 《列王纪》中的理想君王

sections.title: 身份与来历
sections.text: 凯霍斯鲁是波斯史诗《列王纪》中凯扬王朝的君王，出自菲尔多西的叙述，其原型可追溯到更早的中古伊朗传说与《阿维斯陀》传统。他被塑造成智慧、公正与勇武兼备的理想君主，是伊朗民族记忆中极为重要的形象。

sections.title: 主要叙事
sections.text: 他的故事包括少年在土兰受教育、回国夺回王位、为父复仇而与土兰王阿夫拉西亚布长期征战；最终在击败宿敌后，他主动放弃王权，把王位交与卢赫拉斯普，独自隐入雪山，从此不知所终。史诗以他的消失作结，留下“隐遁君王”之说。

sections.title: 象征与辨识
sections.text: 标志是王冠、凯扬之旗与王者灵光，以及他与众英雄并列的宫廷场景。细密画常绘他登基、渡海与雪中隐没的画面，其面容多为蓄须、华服。图像传统晚于史诗文本，多受波斯与中亚绘画风格影响。

sections.title: 流传与文化语境
sections.text: 《列王纪》成书于十至十一世纪，以新波斯语诗体汇集古伊朗传说，是波斯语文学的基石。凯霍斯鲁被后世用以论说公正王权与弃权的智慧；一些伊斯兰与民间传统附会其隐遁与末世期待，但这些说法与史诗文本应加区分。

en.name: Kay Khosrow
en.title: The ideal king of the Shahnameh

sections.title: Identity and origins
sections.text: Kay Khosrow is a king of the Kayani dynasty in Ferdowsi’s Shahnameh, his figure rooted in older Middle Iranian legend and Avestan tradition. He is drawn as the ideal ruler, combining wisdom, justice and martial courage, and stands among the most important figures of Iranian national memory.

sections.title: Key narratives
sections.text: His story takes him to exile and schooling in Turan, back to reclaim the throne, and into long war with Afrasiyab to avenge his father. After defeating his enemy he gives up kingship, hands the throne to Lohrasp and vanishes into the mountains, leaving the epic’s theme of the hidden king.

sections.title: Symbols and attributes
sections.text: Crown, the Kaviani banner and royal glory mark him, together with court scenes shared with the heroes. Miniatures show his enthronement, sea crossings and snowy disappearance, with bearded face and rich robes. This painting tradition postdates the poem and draws on Persian and Central Asian styles.

sections.title: Tradition and context
sections.text: The Shahnameh was completed in the tenth to eleventh centuries, gathering ancient Iranian legend in New Persian verse as a foundation of Persian literature. Later writers cite Khosrow on just rule and the wisdom of renouncing power, while Islamic and folk traditions add hidden-imam expectations distinct from the epic itself.

figures.name: 乌特纳皮什提姆
figures.title: 《吉尔伽美什》中的洪水生还者

sections.title: 身份与来历
sections.text: 乌特纳皮什提姆出自《吉尔伽美什史诗》第十一块泥板，是洪水之后获得永生的智者。他向吉尔伽美什讲述众神决定以洪水灭绝人类，而他受神示造舟，携家眷、工匠与鸟兽渡过洪灾，获赐居于河口之地的永生，其名意为“找到生命者”。

sections.title: 主要叙事
sections.text: 他的洪水叙事与更早的《阿特拉哈西斯》及苏美尔洪水故事同源，情节结构相近：神祇决定毁灭、一人受启示造船、放鸟试探水退、献祭与神祇的悔意。它与《创世记》挪亚的故事有显著平行，但细节、神学与文类并不相同，不宜直接等同。

sections.title: 象征与辨识
sections.text: 标识是方舟、鸽子与燕子、洪水后的献祭与河口之地。泥板上他被称为“远者”，居于诸河汇流之处；史诗借他考验吉尔伽美什，以“永生不可得”作答。图像材料稀少，主要凭泥板文本辨识。

sections.title: 流传与文化语境
sections.text: 泥板于十九世纪在尼尼微的亚述巴尼拔图书馆出土，其洪水段落与圣经的相似性当时引起轰动。学界一般认为美索不达米亚传统更早，但两者关系属共享母题而非简单抄袭。史诗本身也有多个版本与残片，叙述时宜说明其苏美尔、巴比伦与亚述的层次。

en.name: Utnapishtim
en.title: Flood survivor of the Gilgamesh epic

sections.title: Identity and origins
sections.text: Utnapishtim appears on tablet eleven of the Epic of Gilgamesh as the sage made immortal after the flood. He tells Gilgamesh how the gods resolved to destroy humanity, how he was warned to build a boat and carried family, craftsmen and animals through, and was granted life at the river mouths; his name means “he found life”.

sections.title: Key narratives
sections.text: His flood shares a source with the older Atrahasis and Sumerian flood stories: a divine decision, one man warned to build, birds released to test the water, sacrifice and divine regret. It parallels Noah in Genesis markedly, but the details, theology and genre differ, so the two are not the same tale.

sections.title: Symbols and attributes
sections.text: The ark, dove and swallow, the sacrifice after the waters fall, and the place where rivers meet identify him. The tablet calls him “the distant one” at the confluence; the epic uses him to test Gilgamesh and answer that immortality cannot be won. Images are scarce, so the text is the main evidence.

sections.title: Tradition and context
sections.text: The tablet came from Ashurbanipal’s library at Nineveh in the nineteenth century, and its likeness to the Bible caused a sensation. Scholars usually date the Mesopotamian material earlier, while treating the relation as shared motifs rather than simple copying. Multiple recensions exist, Sumerian, Babylonian and Assyrian.

figures.name: 涅尔伽勒
figures.title: 战争、瘟疫与冥府之神

sections.title: 身份与来历
sections.text: 涅尔伽勒是美索不达米亚的冥府之神，兼掌战争与瘟疫。其名早见于苏美尔文献，主要城邦中心为库塔。他原是星神与战神，后被纳入冥界权力结构，与冥后埃蕾什基伽勒并治下界，成为“不再返回之地”的统治者之一。

sections.title: 主要叙事
sections.text: 著名故事讲他因不肯向冥后致敬而被邀入冥府，受胁不得复返，遂夺其权柄并与她成婚，共治冥界。这则神话解释了他由天界神祇转为冥府之主的由来。另有叙事把他与瘟疫、战场上的死亡相连；亚述王常祈求他赐予胜利。

sections.title: 象征与辨识
sections.text: 标志是双狮头权杖、弯刀与火焰，其形象常与瘟疫之热和战争之火相联。天文上他与火星相关，占卜文献视其行星运行预兆战乱与疫病。库塔的神庙、出土的犬形塑像与仪式文本，是辨识其崇拜的重要材料。

sections.title: 流传与文化语境
sections.text: 冥府观念在美索不达米亚宗教中占重要位置：亡者居于尘土之屋，需供祭与记念，涅尔伽勒因此既可怕又不可或缺。他的职能在后期与埃蕾什基伽勒分工明确，也影响了周边地区对冥神的想象。相关研究多依赖泥板文书与印章图像，须注意版本与地方差异。

en.name: Nergal
en.title: God of war, plague and the underworld

sections.title: Identity and origins
sections.text: Nergal is the Mesopotamian god of the underworld who also governs war and plague. His name appears early in Sumerian texts, and his main cult centre was Kutha. Originally a stellar and warrior god, he was drawn into the powers of the netherworld and ruled it with Ereshkigal as lord of the land of no return.

sections.title: Key narratives
sections.text: A famous myth has him enter the underworld because he refused to show deference to its queen, then seize power there when return is denied, marrying Ereshkigal and sharing her rule. This explains his shift from sky god to underworld king. Other texts tie him to pestilence and battle death; Assyrian kings prayed for victory.

sections.title: Symbols and attributes
sections.text: His mace with twin lion heads, curved sword and flames identify him, and he is linked to plague fever and the fire of war. In astronomy he is Mars, whose movements omen texts read as portents of war and disease. Temples at Kutha, dog figurines and ritual texts are the key evidence.

sections.title: Tradition and context
sections.text: Underworld belief mattered greatly in Mesopotamian religion: the dead lived in a house of dust and needed offerings and remembrance, making Nergal both feared and necessary. His later division of roles with Ereshkigal shaped neighbouring ideas of the netherworld. Study rests on tablets and seals, with variant and local versions.

china: 补天与射日叙事的重要早期文献，须注意篇章各自语境。
Early sources for sky repair and the suns; each chapter has its own argumentative context.
不同篇章累积而成的神异地理，不是一部结构统一的神话小说。
A layered collection of extraordinary geography, not a single unified mythic novel.
后世志怪的重要入口，须区分传本整理与更早材料。
An entry into later accounts of the extraordinary, with a complex transmission history.
japan: 公元712年编成；神代谱系与王权叙事互相联系。
Compiled in 712; divine genealogy and accounts of rule are closely connected.
公元720年编成，常并列不同的传承说法。
Compiled in 720; variant accounts are often preserved alongside one another.
各地《风土记》与神社公开资料
地方记录可补充中央编纂文本，但并非所有地域版本均已保存。
Local records complement court compilations, although survival is uneven.
greek: 诸神谱系、权力更替与世界起源的重要诗歌文本。
A major poetic source for divine genealogies and successions.
包括得墨忒耳、阿波罗等颂歌，年代与作者不一。
Hymns to Demeter, Apollo, and other deities; dates and authorship vary.
后世系统整理材料，不能替代更早诗歌与地方传统。
A later mythographic compilation, not a substitute for earlier and local sources.
norse: 中世纪手稿保存的诗歌集，包含《高人之言》《女巫的预言》。
Medieval manuscripts preserve poems including Hávamál and Völuspá.
在基督教时代整理，兼有诗学讲解与叙事。
A Christian-era work combining narrative with explanations of poetic language.
文学记录、地名与物质遗存须分别辨析，不能简单互证。
Literary records, place names, and material evidence require distinct interpretation.
egypt: 时代、受众与具体用途不同，不宜视为同一本统一经典。
Different periods, audiences, and uses; not chapters of one fixed scripture.
更接近可选用的葬仪文本群，传本与篇章组合不同。
A variable collection of funerary compositions rather than one standard volume.
太阳夜航的关键文本，与王室墓葬和再生图景相连。
A key source for the sun’s nocturnal passage, royal burial, and renewal.
celtic: 《爱尔兰战役记》与卢格相关文本
爱尔兰传统的关键文本之一，不代表整个凯尔特世界。
A major Irish source, not a text representing every Celtic tradition.
爱尔兰彼岸航行叙事，注意中世纪文学与宗教交汇的背景。
An Irish otherworld voyage with a medieval literary and religious context.
威尔士叙事集合，须与爱尔兰人物和地理传统区分。
A Welsh narrative collection, distinct from Irish figures and settings.
roman: 奥古斯都时代史诗，罗马祖源被放进特定政治与诗学语境。
An Augustan epic placing Roman ancestry in a particular political and poetic setting.
建城传说与后世史家编排并存，不是同时代目击记录。
Founding traditions shaped by a later historian, not contemporary eyewitness reporting.
围绕节历、地名和仪式讲述，保存差异而非单一教义。
Calendar-based narratives about festivals, places, and rites, not a uniform doctrine.
mesopotamia: 苏美尔语材料，与阿卡德语伊什塔尔下冥界文本相关但不相同。
A Sumerian text related to, but distinct from, Akkadian accounts of Ishtar’s descent.
有苏美尔语故事、古巴比伦与标准巴比伦等不同材料。
Includes Sumerian episodes and differing Old and Standard Babylonian materials.
巴比伦创造史诗，与马尔杜克地位及城市秩序有关。
A Babylonian creation epic linked with Marduk and civic order.
india: 搅乳海等叙事有多个版本，须标明具体文献与宗派语境。
Narratives such as ocean churning vary across texts and devotional settings.
杜尔迦及女神神学的重要文本，仍与敬奉和节庆紧密相关。
A major text of goddess traditions, inseparable from living devotion and festivals.
跨语言流传的史诗传统，版本繁多而非单一不变文本。
Epic traditions transmitted across languages in many evolving versions.
persia: 雨星提什特里亚与旱魔交锋的宗教文本来源。
The religious setting for Tishtrya’s struggle against the drought adversary.
约公元1000年前后成书，需区分史诗英雄与祆教神学身份。
Completed around 1000 CE; epic heroes are not interchangeable with theological figures.
对活态信仰的理解应包括社群自身声音。
Living faith should also be approached through the voices of its communities.
maya: 基切玛雅传统的重要文本，不能代表全部玛雅族群。
A key K’iche’ Maya text, not a scripture representing all Maya peoples.
古典期铭文与陶器图像
须结合具体年代与地点，避免把后世文本直接覆盖早期图像。
Interpret by date and place rather than projecting later texts directly onto earlier images.
玛雅社群公开文化资源
当代语言与传承不可被古代考古叙事抹去。
Contemporary languages and traditions must not be erased by an exclusively ancient focus.
aztec: 纳瓦语传承的重要记录，殖民时期的抄写与解释背景须说明。
An important Nahua account, transmitted within a colonial context.
纳瓦受访者、写作者与殖民编纂者共同参与的复杂文本。
A complex work involving Nahua informants and writers as well as colonial compilation.
《博尔吉亚手抄本》等图像材料
Codex Borgia and related pictorial sources
图像需依文献和语境解读，不能随意套用现代解释。
Pictorial materials require contextual interpretation, not arbitrary modern decoding.
inca: 印卡·加西拉索《印卡王室述评》
保存王室祖源叙事，也有作者家世与殖民时代的立场。
Preserves royal ancestry narratives with the author’s own family and colonial perspectives.
Juan de Betanzos, Narrative of the Incas
十六世纪记录，须比较译介、访谈与编纂过程。
A sixteenth-century account requiring attention to interpretation, testimony, and compilation.
安第斯社群的公开资料
帕查玛玛与瓦卡等概念在当代社群生活中仍有多样实践。
Concepts such as Pachamama and wak’a continue through diverse community practices.
yoruba: 伊多乌《奥洛杜马雷：约鲁巴信仰中的上帝》
E. B. Idowu, Olódùmarè: God in Yoruba Belief
1962年的重要研究，需与其他约鲁巴作者及实践者声音并读。
An influential 1962 study, to be read alongside other Yoruba scholars and practitioners.
阿宾博拉《伊法文学语料阐释》
Wande Abimbola, Ifá: An Exposition of Ifá Literary Corpus
从伊法口述文学传统理解故事、伦理与宗教实践。
An approach through the literary, ethical, and religious contexts of Ifá traditions.
约鲁巴及非洲离散社群公开资源
Public Yoruba and diaspora community resources
跨大西洋传承有关联也有独立发展，不应简单认作完全相同。
Atlantic connections coexist with distinct local developments and identities.
west-africa: 拉特雷《阿坎—阿散蒂民间故事》
1930年的故事记录，有殖民采集与翻译语境，需批判阅读。
A 1930 collection with colonial recording and translation contexts.
阿坎讲述者的公开口述故事
Public stories shared by Akan narrators
讲述方式、回应与具体场合也是故事意义的一部分。
Performance, audience response, and occasion participate in a story’s meaning.
加勒比阿南西传统资料
跨大西洋流传产生新语境，并非对西非版本的静态复制。
Atlantic transmission creates new contexts rather than static copies of West African versions.
polynesia: 毛利社群公开叙事与 Te Ara
Public Māori accounts and Te Ara
应注明具体 iwi、hapū 与来源，不把一版替代所有社区知识。
Identify iwi, hapū, and sources; no version replaces every community’s knowledge.
十九世纪编纂主要基于毛利材料，标题不能证明泛岛群统一传统。
A nineteenth-century compilation chiefly from Māori material, not a universal island canon.
佩蕾等人物须放回夏威夷地景、语言与社群关系。
Figures such as Pele belong within Hawaiian places, language, and community relationships.
aboriginal: 先理解文化权威、族群差异与知识使用规范。
Begin with cultural authority, differences among peoples, and protocols for knowledge.
通过原住民声音理解库林及维多利亚地区的公开文化信息。
Public information grounded in Aboriginal voices from Kulin and Victorian contexts.
相关 Country 的社区文化中心
Community cultural centers on the relevant Country
仅依获准公开的资料阅读，尊重姓名、影像与访问限制。
Use information authorized for public access and respect restrictions on names, images, and places.
korea: 十三世纪编纂保存檀君等祖源叙事，需区分记述年代与传统时间。
A thirteenth-century compilation; distinguish the recording date from narrative chronology.
历史编纂与祖源传说的关系，须结合作者与王朝语境。
Read historiography and founding traditions within their authors’ dynastic contexts.
地区巫歌采录与实践者公开介绍
Regional ritual-song collections and public practitioner accounts
巴里公主等叙事随地区和仪式传承而异。
Narratives such as Bari’s vary with region and ritual lineage.
christianity: 同属犹太教经典和基督教《旧约》，有多种释经传统。
Shared Jewish scripture and the Christian Old Testament, with diverse interpretive traditions.
《路加福音》第24章／《约翰福音》第20章
复活叙事的两个重要文本，细节与写作重点有所不同。
Two major resurrection accounts with distinct details and emphases.
不同教会的公开教理与礼仪资料
Public catechetical and liturgical resources from different churches
天主教、东正教与新教传统的共同点和差异都应得到说明。
Attend to differences as well as common ground among Catholic, Orthodox, and Protestant traditions.

christianity.title: 从圣经叙事到教会传统
christianity.lead: 理解基督教，需要区分经典的故事、教义的表述、历史中的教会与今天的信仰生活。它们彼此关联，却不是同一件事。

sections.title: 一位上帝、三个位格：不是三位神
sections.text: 多数基督教传统以“三位一体”表达对独一上帝的信仰：圣父、圣子与圣灵不是三位彼此独立的神，也不是同一角色轮流更换名字。早期教会经历长期讨论，尼西亚会议及后续会议形成重要的信经用语；不同教派的历史和措辞又有自己的发展。因此，不能把圣父、耶稣和圣灵排成类似希腊神谱的三个席位。耶稣在基督教中的地位，也不只是道德导师或受造天使。主流教会关于道成肉身的教义，将他理解为真正的神与真正的人。这些是介绍信徒如何表述信仰，并非要求读者预先认同。少数自称基督教的团体并不接受经典三位一体教义，也须在讨论具体社群时分辨。
sections.en: Most Christian traditions confess one God as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. The persons are not three independent deities, nor simply one character changing names. Early councils developed the language of creeds through sustained debate. Likewise, Jesus is not merely a moral teacher or a created angel within mainstream Christian theology: the incarnation concerns his full humanity and divinity. These statements describe believers’ understandings without requiring readers to adopt them. Some communities identifying as Christian reject classical Trinitarian doctrine, so the specific community still matters.

sections.title: 圣经为何不是一本单一作者的书
sections.text: 基督教圣经是一组在不同历史条件下形成、经社群传承而被收入正典的文献。律法、叙事、诗歌、智慧文学、先知书、福音书、书信与启示文学，不能都用同一种阅读方式处理。《创世记》属于犹太教经典，同时也是基督教《旧约》的一部分；把其中人物只归为“基督教人物”，会抹去文本的犹太历史。《新约》的四部福音书也并非逐字相同的四份记录：故事安排、叙述角度和神学重点存在差异。天主教、东正教和多数新教对于旧约正典的范围亦不完全相同。阅读时，版本序言、注释、成书背景与文体辨识，比把所有句子直接拼成一张时间表更有帮助。
sections.en: The Christian Bible is a collection of writings formed and transmitted in different historical settings. Law, poetry, wisdom, prophecy, Gospel, letter, and apocalypse require attention to genre. Genesis belongs to Jewish scripture as well as the Christian Old Testament; calling its figures exclusively Christian erases that history. The four Gospels have distinct arrangements and emphases rather than identical wording. Catholic, Orthodox, and most Protestant traditions also differ over the extent of the Old Testament canon. Introductions, annotations, and literary context therefore matter.

sections.title: 耶稣的生命：教导、受难与复活
sections.text: 福音书将耶稣的活动放在一世纪的加利利和犹太地区。他宣讲上帝的国，借比喻教导，与不同处境的人相遇，并医治病者、召集门徒。理解这些故事，需要记得他与最早的门徒本身处于犹太生活与经典的语境之中，不能把后来教会的边界直接套回每一个场景。受难叙事讲述他在罗马统治下被钉十字架；复活见证则成为基督教福音宣告的核心。历史研究会讨论文本、社会背景及证据能支持什么，教会的信仰告白还包含神学判断，二者的任务并不完全相同。尤其必须拒绝以受难故事归罪整个犹太民族；这种错误解读曾带来严重迫害，也受到许多教会的明确反省与否定。
sections.en: The Gospels place Jesus in first-century Galilee and Judaea. He teaches in parables, announces God’s kingdom, heals, and gathers disciples within a Jewish setting. His crucifixion under Roman rule and the proclamation of resurrection become central to Christian faith. Historical scholarship and theological confession ask related but not identical questions. Later church boundaries should not simply be projected onto every scene. Collective blame against Jewish people for the crucifixion is a harmful misreading with a history of persecution, explicitly repudiated by many churches.

sections.title: 天使、圣徒与玛利亚：身份不相同
sections.text: 天使在基督教中是受造的使者，不与上帝处在同一类别。加百列与报喜相连，米迦勒则常出现于守护和对抗邪恶的叙述。使徒、殉道者与其他圣徒是人，不是增添到上帝身边的次级神明。玛利亚作为耶稣的母亲，在天主教和东正教礼仪中有极突出的地位；敬礼并不等于把她视为上帝。新教各传统对圣徒代祷、圣像和玛利亚敬礼的理解与实践存在差异。艺术中的光环、翅膀、百合、钥匙或书卷等符号，需要放回具体人物与地区的图像传统；不能仅凭一件配饰就认定所有画作具有相同身份和含义。
sections.en: Angels are created messengers, not lesser gods. Gabriel is associated with annunciation, while Michael often appears in protection and conflict with evil. Apostles, martyrs, and saints are human figures. Catholic and Orthodox veneration of Mary does not make her God; Protestant attitudes toward Marian devotion, saints’ intercession, and images vary. Halos, wings, lilies, keys, and books belong to particular artistic conventions. Their meanings depend on the figure, period, place, and setting rather than a single universal visual code.

sections.title: 不同教会如何活出同一传统
sections.text: 天主教、东正教与众多新教教会共有许多经典和信仰语言，但其权威结构、礼仪、圣礼观和历史经验并不一致。东正教并不是一个由单一中央教宗管理的组织；新教也不是只有一套统一礼拜方式。圣诞节纪念耶稣诞生，复活节纪念复活，节期历法和礼仪细节可能因教会而异。洗礼、圣餐、祈祷、共同敬拜和照顾弱者，在不同传统中以不同形式成为信仰生活的部分。教堂建筑从简朴会堂到大教堂都有，不宜用哥特式建筑代表所有基督徒。本站的尖拱与彩窗只是艺术主题，不是关于“真正基督教长什么样”的标准。
sections.en: Catholic, Orthodox, and Protestant churches share important scriptures and beliefs while differing in authority, worship, sacraments, and historical experience. Orthodoxy does not have one central pope; Protestantism is not one uniform worship style. Christmas and Easter, baptism and communion, prayer and care take varied forms. Calendars can differ. Buildings range from simple meeting places to cathedrals. This website’s arches and stained glass are an artistic theme, not a visual standard for authentic Christianity.

china.title: 在山海、天庭与人间之间
china.lead: 中国神话不是一部由单一作者写成的经典，而是跨越文献、地方信仰、节俗与后世文学的众多叙事。

sections.title: 为什么不存在唯一的创世时间线
sections.text: 盘古开天、女娲造人、女娲补天、伏羲相关叙事以及阴阳化生等观念，来自不同时代与文类，未必原本就属于一条连贯故事。把它们排成固定年表，固然方便入门，却容易制造古人从未统一认可的顺序。《山海经》的神异地理、《淮南子》的哲学论述与后来的志怪各有写作目的，不能互相当作缺失章节。现代整理经常从散见片段重建一套中国神话，这种工作有价值，但重建本身也应被看见。阅读某位人物时，先问出处和年代，往往比急着确定他在神谱中排第几更重要。
sections.en: Pangu, Nüwa, Fuxi, and accounts of transformation through yin and yang come from different texts and periods. They did not necessarily begin as episodes of one continuous narrative. Modern timelines can help orientation but may create a sequence never universally accepted in earlier communities. Mythic geography, philosophical argument, and later accounts of the extraordinary have different aims. Always ask where a figure appears and when a source was recorded before placing that figure in a fixed divine hierarchy.

sections.title: 神话人物与民间信仰如何交错
sections.text: 西王母在早期文献中的形象，与后世仙界宴会中的王母娘娘并不完全相同。玉皇大帝的天庭秩序，也不能无差别地倒推为上古材料的原始背景。地方神、祖先、山川之灵与佛道传统不断发生联系，一位人物可能同时拥有地方祠庙、文学故事和宗教称号。神明的职能并非永远不变，敬奉者也不会只按现代百科的单一标签生活。因而，“掌管什么”只是一个入口；谁在何处敬奉、相关节日如何形成、故事怎样被改写，同样构成人物的历史。
sections.en: Early descriptions of the Queen Mother of the West differ from later portrayals in immortal banquets. The Jade Emperor’s court should not be projected indiscriminately into every ancient source. Local deities, ancestors, landscape powers, Buddhism, and Daoism interact across time. A figure may have temples, literary adventures, and religious titles without those being identical. Asking who venerates a figure, where, and through which festivals is as important as assigning a single divine responsibility.

sections.title: 从补天与治水，看见修复的伦理
sections.text: 女娲补天不只是奇观：破损的世界需要重新建立秩序，生命才能继续。羿射九日触及力量的节制与共同生活的条件，大禹治水则将灾变、劳动、地理与政治权威联结。不同版本对英雄的行动和代价并不完全一致，不能把每篇故事都变成一句整齐的励志道理。更有意思的读法，是观察人物在何种失衡中出场，他们依赖哪些材料、同伴或神圣资源，以及完成事业后仍留下什么难题。传说保存的不只成功，也有损失、边界和无法彻底弥补的后果。
sections.en: Nüwa’s sky repair concerns the restoration of conditions for life. Yi’s arrows confront excessive solar power; Yu’s flood work joins labor, geography, and political authority. These are not merely illustrations of one simple moral. Follow the imbalance that calls a figure into action, the materials and assistance involved, and the consequences that remain afterward. Different tellings preserve losses and unresolved tensions alongside achievement.

japan.title: 从神代谱系到地方神社
japan.lead: 日本神话中的神并非只是一组超自然人物；山林、海洋、谷物、祖先与地方祭祀，都参与了神圣关系的形成。

sections.title: 《古事记》与《日本书纪》为何要并读
sections.text: 《古事记》与《日本书纪》分别在八世纪初编成，神代叙事与王权祖源密切相连。《日本书纪》还经常以“一书曰”等形式并列不同说法，提醒我们当时已有传承差异。相同人物的出生次序、行动和亲缘可能不一致，不能把这些差别全部擦平。它们既是理解早期日本思想的入口，也是特定政治与书写环境中的作品。后来的绘卷、戏剧、神社介绍和现代动画，会继续改变人物的面貌；版本的传播史不能代替对早期文本的辨析。
sections.en: The Kojiki and Nihon shoki were compiled in the early eighth century and connect divine ancestry with rule. The Nihon shoki often preserves alternatives rather than one uncontested account. Births, relationships, and actions can differ. These works illuminate early traditions while also belonging to particular political and literary settings. Later paintings, theater, shrine interpretation, and popular media reshape the figures further; those later forms should not silently replace the earlier sources.

sections.title: 从黄泉到禊祓：边界与更新
sections.text: 伊邪那岐追寻伊邪那美的故事，把生与死之间的边界置于神代叙事中心。黄泉不应简单等同于基督教的地狱，其意义与死、污秽及不可逆转的分离相关。伊邪那岐归来后的禊祓，又与天照、月读、须佐之男等神的出现相连。污秽并不自动等于道德罪责，清净也不能只理解为普通清洁。神话、仪式和后世宗教解释之间有关联，但具体祭祀如何形成，需要另查历史资料，不能从一个故事直接推出所有神社实践。
sections.en: Izanagi’s journey after Izanami places the boundary of life and death at the center of the narrative. Yomi is not simply the Christian hell. His subsequent purification relates to the emergence of Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susanoo. Pollution is not automatically moral guilt, nor purity merely ordinary cleanliness. Stories and rituals are related, but one episode cannot establish the history of every shrine practice.

sections.title: 天岩户与出云：秩序不是独自完成的
sections.text: 天照隐入岩户后，黑暗并不是由某位最强者单独驱散。天宇受卖的舞蹈、众神的笑声、镜与祭仪安排共同促成太阳再现。须佐之男在出云斩杀八岐大蛇，则连接灾害、婚姻和神宝的来历；大国主的故事进一步呈现国土经营和让国叙事。宫廷文本里的秩序与地方记忆并不总能完全重合。访问神社或阅读地方资料时，应留意主祭神的具体称名、社传与祭礼，而不是把所有地方神都归入一张固定全国神谱。
sections.en: Amaterasu’s return from the rock door depends on dance, laughter, mirrors, and collective preparation, not one strongest hero. Susanoo’s serpent encounter connects danger, marriage, and a sacred treasure; Ōkuninushi’s narratives concern land-making and the transfer of authority. Courtly order and local memory do not always coincide. Shrine names, local histories, and festivals therefore deserve attention beyond a supposedly fixed national pantheon.

greek.title: 城邦、诗人与并不完美的众神
greek.lead: 希腊神话的魅力，不来自一套毫无矛盾的神学，而来自诗歌、祭仪与城市之间不断展开的讲述。

sections.title: 奥林匹斯之前：权力怎样获得来历
sections.text: 赫西俄德《神谱》从卡俄斯等最初存在展开，盖亚、乌拉诺斯、克洛诺斯与宙斯之间的冲突构成代际权力更替。世界的形成与统治的确立相互交织，而不是先有一张完成的宇宙地图，再把诸神安排进去。提坦并不简单等于邪恶巨人，宙斯也不是现代意义上全知、全善且绝对无所不能的唯一神。神谱中的亲缘关系建立联系，也制造冲突；不同诗人与地方传统会调整细节。所谓十二奥林匹斯神的名单，也并非在所有场合完全一致。
sections.en: Hesiod’s Theogony links the emergence of the world with successive struggles among divine generations. Gaia, Ouranos, Kronos, and Zeus do not simply occupy a pre-existing cosmic chart. Titans are not merely evil giants, and Zeus is not a modern philosophical definition of an omnipotent, omniscient sole God. Kinship both connects and divides the divine community. Sources and local traditions vary, including the membership of the familiar twelve Olympians.

sections.title: 神的矛盾，与城邦生活的具体需要
sections.text: 雅典娜关联城邦、工艺与有组织的战争，阿波罗同时涉及音乐、预言、瘟疫和医治；一位神的职能不必符合现代的单一职业划分。神话中的行为也不应直接当成每位敬奉者的道德准则。雅典、德尔斐、奥林匹亚和厄琉西斯各有重要圣地与祭仪，地方称号、节期和空间实践会改变我们理解人物的方式。史诗里的神、悲剧里的神与祭仪中的神，虽然相互关联，却不能简单互换。看见这些差别，比只记“谁掌管爱情、谁掌管海洋”更接近真实复杂的希腊世界。
sections.enTitle: Deities in the life of cities
sections.en: Athena concerns cities, crafts, and organized warfare; Apollo spans music, prophecy, plague, and healing. Divine roles do not resemble single modern occupations. Narrative behavior is not automatically a worshipper’s moral rule. Athens, Delphi, Olympia, and Eleusis each had particular sanctuaries and practices. A deity in epic, tragedy, and local ritual belongs to connected but distinct contexts. Place, titles, festivals, and performance make a simple list of departments inadequate.

sections.title: 英雄越过界限，也必须面对后果
sections.text: 普罗米修斯为人类取得火，珀耳塞福涅的离去使大地经历失收，英雄的选择因而影响整个共同体。英雄并不总是现代的道德榜样：傲慢、误认、亲族义务和预言常使成功与灾难纠缠。悲剧尤其善于让一项看似正当的责任与另一项责任相撞。读到某位人物的结局时，可以追问叙事如何处理限制、死亡与记忆，而不是只判断他赢了没有。罗马作者及后世欧洲艺术会继续改写这些故事；那些重要作品属于接受史，不应全部被当作古希腊原始版本。
sections.en: Fire, lost harvests, prophecy, and family duties make individual choices matters of collective survival. Greek heroes are not always modern moral role models. Pride and misrecognition complicate achievement; tragedy often pits legitimate obligations against each other. Ask how a narrative treats limits, death, and remembrance rather than simply who wins. Roman and later European adaptations remain important, but they belong to reception history rather than one original Greek version.

norse.title: 世界树下，知识与命运的代价
norse.lead: 北欧诸神并非永远安全地站在命运之外。他们通过交换、牺牲与冒险争取秩序，同时面对无法轻易撤销的终局。

sections.title: 我们今天读到的“古老神话”如何留下
sections.text: 北欧神话的重要材料由中世纪冰岛手稿保存，记录时代与更早的非基督教敬奉之间存在距离。《诗体埃达》收录的诗并非同一人、同一时刻的创作，斯诺里的《散文埃达》则在基督教环境中整理诗学与叙事。文学记录与考古、地名、图像可相互启发，却不应被简单拼成一本完整的维京教科书。现代流行文化往往强化神明之间的固定家庭关系，或把九界画成整齐的行政区；早期材料实际上更零散，空间与名称也并非总能严丝合缝地对应。
sections.en: Medieval Icelandic manuscripts preserve crucial accounts at a distance from earlier pre-Christian worship. The Poetic Edda contains poems of different histories; Snorri wrote about poetry and narrative in a Christian setting. Literature, archaeology, place names, and images inform one another without yielding a complete Viking handbook. Modern family trees and nine-world maps often appear much more orderly than the surviving sources warrant.

sections.title: 世界树、边界与不断进行的维护
sections.text: 尤克特拉希尔将不同存在和地点联结起来，但它不是一棵毫发无伤的装饰树。根部、泉水、啃咬者与维护者共同显示世界依赖持续照料。诸神与巨人也不是简单的善恶阵营：他们之间有婚姻、亲缘、交换和知识传递。索尔经常守护边界，奥丁不断寻求消息与智慧，弗蕾雅与丰饶、欲望、战争和魔法相连。洛基尤其难以用“纯粹邪神”概括，他有时制造危机、有时帮助解决危机，而某些行动最终使关系破裂。人物的复杂性正来自这些彼此牵连的功能。
sections.enTitle: A world maintained, not merely built
sections.en: Yggdrasil connects beings and places while itself requiring care and enduring harm. Gods and giants are not simple camps of good and evil: marriages, kinship, exchanges, and knowledge cross their boundaries. Thor often defends; Odin seeks costly wisdom; Freyja has multiple associations. Loki alternately provokes and resolves crises before relationships become irreparable. Their complexity lies in entanglement, not fixed moral departments.

sections.title: 求知与诸神黄昏：结局并不抹去行动
sections.text: 奥丁悬树求取卢恩、以眼换取智慧的相关叙事，把知识写成有代价的获得，而非权力自带的装饰。诸神黄昏则让强大的神也面对死亡、火与世界秩序崩解。然而部分文本还描绘大地重新升起、幸存者相遇与生命延续，不能只剩“所有人都死了”的结论。对于终局图景是否受到基督教环境影响，研究者有不同讨论，宜保留证据与争议的层次。故事提出的难题不是如何保证永远胜利，而是在知道损失可能到来时，责任、勇气和关系为何仍值得维系。
sections.enTitle: Costly wisdom and a world beyond ending
sections.en: Odin’s ordeals make knowledge costly rather than an effortless possession of power. Ragnarök brings death, fire, and the collapse of order, yet some texts also envision an earth emerging again and life continuing. Scholarly discussions about Christian influence on these visions remain complex. The central question is not how to guarantee permanent victory, but why responsibility and relationships still matter when loss cannot simply be prevented.

india.title: 多种道路，不是一张统一神谱
india.lead: 印度教包含多样的哲学、仪式、敬奉与地方传统。史诗故事、神像辨识和信仰实践应彼此联系，也应保持区别。

sections.title: 经典并不是只有一个层次
sections.text: 吠陀赞歌、奥义书、史诗和往世书拥有不同形成历史及权威位置，不能全部叫作同一时期写下的“印度神话”。同一人物在不同宗派文本中的地位可能改变；毗湿奴、湿婆或女神的敬奉，各自发展出强调不同核心的神学。梵天、毗湿奴、湿婆的“三相”图式有助于初识，却不能覆盖所有印度教生活，更不能被误解为基督教三位一体的另一种名字。经典阅读还跨越梵语、泰米尔语及其他众多语言，地方文学与口述传统并非次要的附录。
sections.enTitle: Texts have different histories and roles
sections.en: Vedic hymns, Upanishads, epics, and Puranas have different histories and positions of authority. Devotional traditions centered on Vishnu, Shiva, or the Goddess develop distinct theological emphases. The Trimurti is an introductory scheme, not a complete account of Hindu life and not another name for the Christian Trinity. Sanskrit and many regional languages sustain influential written and oral inheritances.

sections.title: 敬奉、节庆与日常生活
sections.text: 供奉礼拜、瞻礼、家庭与寺庙仪式、朝圣及节庆，为许多社群建立人与神圣者的关系，但具体做法因地区、家庭、宗派和个人选择而异。排灯节不是在所有地方都只庆祝同一个事件，九夜节与象头神节也有多样形式。佛法、业、轮回与解脱等概念则涉及复杂哲学，不能简化为“做好事就立刻得到奖励”。学习某位神明的故事时，可以同时了解其寺庙、节庆、经典和敬奉者自身的解释，而不把活态宗教当作只供收藏角色的幻想背景。
sections.en: Puja, darshan, household and temple rites, pilgrimage, and festivals establish sacred relationships for many communities, with significant local and personal variation. Diwali does not commemorate only one identical event everywhere. Dharma, karma, rebirth, and liberation involve philosophical complexity, not instant rewards for good behavior. Study a figure alongside texts, temples, festivals, and practitioners’ own explanations.

egypt.title: 神庙、太阳与再生的秩序
egypt.lead: 古埃及宗教绵延数千年。不同城市的创造观、王权与葬仪，不应被压成一份永恒不变的神明名单。

sections.title: 多种创造观为什么可以并存
sections.text: 赫利奥波利斯、孟斐斯与赫尔摩波利斯等地拥有不同的创造叙述，太阳、原初水域、言语、神圣组合等各有重点。它们不必像现代竞赛答案那样只准留下一套。拉与阿蒙等神还可形成复合称谓，但不意味着原有神格完全消失。神庙的地方身份、王朝政治与祭仪语言共同影响人物地位；同名神在不同地点也可能以不同形态受到敬奉。学习时先确定时代和地点，往往比试图画出唯一父母谱系更有效。
sections.en: Heliopolis, Memphis, and Hermopolis emphasize different creative processes and divine groupings. Their accounts need not compete for one exclusively correct slot. Composite names such as Amun-Ra connect identities without simply deleting earlier ones. Local temples, dynastic politics, and ritual language shape divine importance. Begin with place and period rather than demanding one universal genealogy.

sections.title: 死亡不是故事的简单终止
sections.text: 奥西里斯相关叙事把身体修复、合法继承与死后存在相连；拉的夜航则让每日太阳升起成为持续战胜危险的再生过程。《亡灵书》的称量心脏图景关涉秩序、真理与责任，但并非所有埃及人、所有时代都使用一套完全相同的葬仪文本。墓葬、器物和图像还受身份与资源影响。把金字塔、木乃伊及动物头像都当作猎奇元素，会忽略其背后对于生命延续、共同秩序和人与神关系的认真思考。
sections.en: Osiris traditions connect restored bodies, legitimate succession, and existence after death. Ra’s nightly journey makes sunrise an ongoing renewal against danger. Weighing the heart concerns order and responsibility, but funerary compositions vary across periods and people. Burials and objects also depend on social position and resources. These traditions merit more than an exotic collection of pyramids and animal heads.

mesopotamia.title: 城市、书写与人的限度
mesopotamia.lead: “两河神话”跨越苏美尔语、阿卡德语及不同城市与帝国的长历史，不是一个国家的一部统一经典。

sections.title: 神明与城市的历史关系
sections.text: 乌鲁克、尼普尔、埃里都和巴比伦各有重要神庙与神学传统。恩基与埃阿、伊南娜与伊什塔尔之间有语言与历史联系，却不应把每一篇苏美尔叙事直接替换神名后当作阿卡德文本。《埃努玛·埃利什》提升马尔杜克的地位，也关乎巴比伦的政治与祭仪秩序；它不能自动代表所有两河时期的创世观。泥板文本的断片、抄写和现代复原也影响我们今天读到的版本。
sections.en: Uruk, Nippur, Eridu, and Babylon maintain distinctive temple and theological histories. Connections between Enki and Ea or Inanna and Ishtar do not make every text interchangeable by renaming. Enuma Elish concerns Marduk and Babylon’s order, not every Mesopotamian worldview. Fragmentary tablets, copying, and modern reconstruction also shape present translations.

sections.title: 英雄为什么不能取得永生
sections.text: 吉尔伽美什在恩奇都死后追问死亡，远行寻找乌特纳皮什提姆，却无法把特殊的幸存经历变成人人可用的不死办法。失去青春植物的情节，又让占有生命的愿望遭遇挫折。伊南娜下冥界则表现边界、权能被剥离与替代的代价。这些故事并不只是古人解释天气的工具，也在探索身体、友谊、王权与人的限度；文本的文学结构与情感变化值得逐段阅读。
sections.en: After Enkidu dies, Gilgamesh seeks Utnapishtim but cannot turn an exceptional survival into immortality available to everyone. Losing the rejuvenating plant further frustrates possession of life. Inanna’s descent explores stripped authority, boundaries, and substitution. These works investigate bodies, friendship, kingship, and human limits rather than merely explaining natural phenomena.

celtic.title: “凯尔特”之下，先认清不同的地方
celtic.lead: 爱尔兰、威尔士与古代大陆地区相关，却不共享一部可以随意互换人物的经典。

sections.title: 名字相似，不等于人物相同
sections.text: 爱尔兰的达努神族、乌拉德英雄与芬恩故事群，和威尔士《马比诺吉昂》的叙事世界，各有语言、手稿与地方背景。古代高卢铭文中出现的神名，也不能只因词形相似就直接补成一部中世纪爱尔兰人物传记。现存重要文本多在基督教时期书写，较早传统、文学创新与抄写环境相互交织。异界可能通过海、丘冢或特殊相遇呈现，并不等于一张所有讲述者共用的地下地图。阅读卢格、库丘林或里安农时，先认清故事群与地理语境，便能避免把“凯尔特神话”误当成一个古代统一国家的宗教。
sections.en: Irish divine, Ulster, and Fenian narratives have different settings from the Welsh Mabinogi. Ancient continental inscriptions cannot simply fill gaps in medieval Irish biographies because names look related. Christian-era manuscripts combine inherited material and literary development. Otherworld encounters through sea, mounds, and unexpected meetings do not establish one universal map. Identify language, place, and narrative cycle before combining figures.

roman.title: 神明、城市与公共生活
roman.lead: 罗马宗教不只是给希腊神换上拉丁名字。地方祭仪、家庭关系与城市历史同样重要。

sections.title: 文学神话之外，还有什么
sections.text: 埃涅阿斯的远行和罗慕路斯的建城，为城市与统治提供祖源；农神节、伏尔甘节与雅努斯之门，则体现节历、火险和战争和平之间的公共关系。朱庇特、朱诺与密涅瓦的卡庇托敬奉有具体的城市空间，家中祖先、拉瑞斯及佩纳忒斯又涉及家庭延续。维吉尔、奥维德和李维所写的故事，各有政治与文学目的，不能被读成全体罗马人逐条接受的一本教义问答。帝国疆域中的地方实践也并不一致。比较罗马与希腊人物时，可以问：名字之外，节日、神庙、社会角色和叙事重点究竟改变了什么？
sections.en: Aeneas and Romulus provide civic ancestry, while festivals and Janus’s gates connect religion with calendars, fire risk, war, and peace. Capitoline worship occupies particular urban space; ancestors, Lares, and Penates concern households. Virgil, Ovid, and Livy have different purposes, not one universal catechism. Provincial practices vary. Comparison with Greece should include festivals, temples, social roles, and narrative emphasis, not names alone.

persia.title: 祆教信仰与波斯史诗，关联但不等同
persia.lead: 阿维斯陀的礼仪语言、后世宇宙论与《列王纪》的英雄伦理，需要分别辨认。

sections.title: 不要把一切都叫作“波斯神话”
sections.text: 祆教仍有延续至今的社群。阿胡拉·马兹达、善恶的冲突及真理与良善行动的价值，属于有复杂历史的宗教思想，不能简化成两个同等力量的漫画阵营。祆教对火的重视也不等于把普通火焰当成唯一上帝；洁净、光与礼仪责任具有特定意义。《列王纪》则在伊斯兰时代以波斯语诗歌保存更早的王朝与英雄传说，鲁斯塔姆、扎尔和苏赫拉布的悲剧是文学史诗，不是每一细节都对应一项宗教教义。现代民族想象、博物馆图像和活态宗教的声音，应放在不同层次比较。
sections.en: Zoroastrian communities remain living. Ahura Mazda, truth, good action, and opposition to evil belong to complex religious histories, not two cartoon teams. Reverence for fire does not mean worshipping ordinary flame as the sole deity. The Shahnameh, composed in Persian in the Islamic period, preserves older royal and heroic material. Rostam’s tragedies are literary epic, not a direct doctrinal code. Keep religion, literary reception, and national imagery distinct.

korea.title: 祖源、地方与仍在演唱的故事
korea.lead: 建国叙事和仪式巫歌不是同一种体裁，也没有必要被强行编入一个神圣家庭。

sections.title: 从檀君到钵里公主
sections.text: 檀君、朱蒙与济州三姓祖源各自联系不同群体的来历和地方权威。《三国史记》《三国遗事》等记录的写作年代，与故事声称的时间相隔很远，理解其叙事意义不等于确认所有年代都已获得考古证明。钵里公主的远行则在地域性仪式传统中获得意义，照护、死亡与引导亡者的主题与具体表演场合相连。社群保留的巫歌、地方神话与现代影视又会继续改写。读者可以在文本比较中学习，却不宜把公开故事当作主持仪式的操作说明，更不应认为韩国宗教生活只由这些故事构成。
sections.en: Dangun, Jumong, and Jeju ancestry accounts concern different communities and places. Medieval compilations are much later than their narrative chronologies; meaning is not archaeological verification. Bari’s journeys belong to regional ritual performance, care, death, and guidance. Local songs and modern screen adaptations continue changing the accounts. Public stories are not procedural ritual manuals, nor a complete description of Korean religious life.

maya.title: 不是一个被遗忘的统一古国
maya.lead: 玛雅语言、地区与历史时期众多，今天仍有社群延续自己的生活和知识。

sections.title: 基切文本与古典期图像怎样比较
sections.text: 《波波尔·乌》是进入基切玛雅传统的重要入口，英雄双子、玉米造人与祖先迁行在其中形成文学结构。古典期低地城市的铭文、陶器和造像则来自不同年代与政治环境。它们之间可能存在可研究的联系，但不能用一部较晚记录的文本给每一幅古代图像强行命名。球戏既是具体实践，也可进入冥界较量的叙事；玉米不只是普通食材，还关联身体、共同生活与土地。现存社群的语言、宗教实践与地方知识同样重要，不应只剩旅游宣传中“突然消失的文明”与末日预言的误解。
sections.en: The Popol Wuj is a major K’iche’ source, not a universal key to every Classic lowland image. Inscriptions, vessels, and sculptures belong to distinct periods and political settings. Ballgames are practices and narrative devices; maize concerns bodies, land, and collective life. Living Maya languages and knowledge deserve attention beyond tourism’s misleading tales of a vanished civilization or supposed apocalypse.

aztec.title: 太阳、土地与互惠的代价
aztec.lead: 墨西加国家宗教处于更广的纳瓦与中美洲世界之中，不能代替所有当地传统。

sections.title: 从创造叙事回到具体社会
sections.text: 第五太阳的点燃、羽蛇寻找骨骸及玉米的来历，使生命被理解为需要神圣行动和承继的存在。战争、王权与献奉又进入具体国家制度，不能只用抽象的自然循环解释。历史献祭应被准确说明，但猎奇的场面并不是认识一个文化的全部；农作、诗歌、家庭、工艺与节历同样参与生活。图绘手抄本、纳瓦语文字记录与西班牙殖民作者，保存了不同立场和信息。今天纳瓦社群仍在，现代艺术中的人物形象也有重新创造；古代帝国的制度不能直接投射到每一个当代原住民身上。
sections.en: The Fifth Sun, recovered bones, and maize origins make life a matter of divine action and inheritance. Warfare and offerings also belong to particular state institutions, not abstract nature cycles alone. Describe sacrifice accurately without reducing a culture to spectacle. Agriculture, poetry, households, and skilled work matter. Pictorial and written sources have differing perspectives; ancient imperial practices cannot be imposed on living Nahua identities.

inca.title: 太阳王朝之外，还有山川与地方
inca.lead: 印加国家曾整合众多安第斯族群。库斯科的王室祖源不是整个安第斯唯一的记忆。

sections.title: 瓦卡、帕查与互惠关系
sections.text: 瓦卡可以指神圣地点、物体或存在，泉、岩、山及祖先遗存都可能具有具体社群意义。帕查兼有时间与空间的意涵，现代常见的三层世界图不能被当成所有历史材料共同使用的一张剖面图。王室关于太阳血缘和建城的讲述，与各地起源地点、山岳关系和互惠馈赠并存。《瓦罗奇里手稿》尤其呈现地方神圣者和竞争，不能把其中人物不加区别地编成印加宫廷的臣属。今日盖丘亚、艾马拉及其他社群与天主教等传统形成多样联系，也不是被冻结在帝国灭亡前一刻的标本。
sections.en: Wak’a can describe sacred places, objects, or presences within specific relationships. Pacha concerns time and space; modern three-world diagrams are not universal historical cross-sections. Solar royal ancestry coexists with local mountains and origin places. Huarochiri materials present local sacred conflicts, not merely an Inca court hierarchy. Contemporary Quechua, Aymara, and other communities have diverse religious relationships and are not frozen imperial remnants.

yoruba.title: 奥里沙、阿谢与活的传承
yoruba.lead: 人物故事只能打开一扇门，不能代替约鲁巴社群自身的宗教知识与实践。

sections.title: 关系比固定职能表更重要
sections.text: 奥里沙的地方名号、职责、性别表现和故事，可能随城市与传承变化。阿谢常被译作实现力量或效力，但一个简短译词无法代替其宗教语境。奥洛杜马雷的至高地位，也不意味着所有日常关系只面向一位具鲜明冒险传记的神王。伊法的奥杜、诗句、占卜者训练与解释构成知识体系，不是从网站复制符号就能操作的算法。大西洋离散中形成的宗教与约鲁巴传统有历史联系，也有独立的发展和权威，不能只以相似名字认定所有仪式相同。公开学习应尊重传承者，尤其区分介绍与资格授予。
sections.en: Orisha titles, roles, forms, and narratives vary with place and lineage. Ase cannot be exhausted by a short translation such as enabling power. Ifa involves extensive verses, trained interpretation, and religious authority, not a copied algorithm. Atlantic diaspora religions share historical connections while developing distinct institutions. Similar names do not establish identical ceremonies. Public education does not confer initiation or ritual qualifications.

west-africa.title: 先说阿坎，再谈更广的西非
west-africa.lead: 这个入口聚焦阿坎与阿南西故事，不声称西非所有民族共用一个神系。

sections.title: 讲述中的智谋、合作与反转
sections.text: 阿南西有时是蜘蛛，有时像有妻儿、要吃饭的普通人。他的机智可以成功，也可能暴露贪心、偏见或短视；故事并非永远赞美欺骗。阿索的建议、恩蒂库马的提醒和动物对手的反应，说明智慧并不总属于最响亮的主角。公开口述故事还包括讲者与听众的回应、表演节奏及场合，书面儿童版可能删去这些。跨大西洋传播让加勒比地区的阿南西进入新的语言和权力环境，既有传承也有创造。将尼亚梅、阿萨塞娅与故事动物分清身份，便不会把每个有名字的角色都误当成神明。
sections.en: Anansi succeeds and fails within recognizable households and exchanges. Tales expose greed and narrow judgment as well as resourcefulness. Aso and Ntikuma reveal intelligence beyond the central trickster. Oral performance includes audience response, rhythm, and occasion that children’s books may omit. Caribbean transmission creates new contexts. Nyame, Asase Yaa, and named animals have different statuses; a proper name does not make every character a deity.

polynesia.title: 海洋连接众岛，却没有抹去差异
polynesia.lead: 毛利、夏威夷、汤加、萨摩亚与其他岛群拥有各自语言、谱系及故事权威。

sections.title: 比较之前，先保留岛屿的名字
sections.text: 毛伊、希娜与唐加罗瓦等名字在不同岛群出现，并不表示所有亲缘和冒险都能互相拼接。毛利的天地分离、夏威夷佩蕾的火山家族及不同地方的航海传统，各自在特定土地与社群关系中获得意义。谱系不只是人物出生表，还能说明人、环境和责任如何相连。独木舟、颚骨鱼钩和卡帕树皮布等器物，也有真实技艺背景，不能全当作游戏道具。殖民采录的英文标题有时比实际材料范围更宽，阅读时应核对故事究竟来自哪里，以及哪些公开知识适合在当前场合分享。
sections.en: Related names such as Maui, Hina, and Tangaroa do not authorize combining every genealogy and adventure. Māori separation accounts and Hawaiian volcanic families belong within particular relationships. Genealogy can express environmental responsibilities as well as birth. Canoes, hooks, and kapa have skilled material histories. Colonial collections sometimes use titles broader than their evidence. Always identify origin, custodianship, and the suitability of public sharing.

aboriginal.title: Country、社群与知识边界
aboriginal.lead: 本入口只是公开通识。它不提供一套“全澳神话”，也不会把受限的神圣知识改写成娱乐素材。

sections.title: 土地不是神话发生的空白舞台
sections.text: Country 包括土地、水、天空、祖先、生命与责任，含义由具体族群的语言和关系塑造。库林的邦吉尔和瓦阿、努恩加尔的瓦吉尔、昆温库的恩加约德，不能被安排进一个人为统一的祖神家族。英语“梦时”等词也只是对不同本地概念的不充分翻译，不能暗示祖先只存在于一个彻底结束的过去。公开展览、旧书出版或网络可见，不自动代表可以复制图案、拍摄地点或向任何人转述所有内容。学习路线应从相关传统守护者选择公开的资料开始，承认知识不是只有“我能否搜到”这一种访问规则。
sections.enTitle: Country is not an empty stage
sections.en: Country includes land, water, sky, ancestors, beings, and responsibilities through specific languages and relationships. Kulin, Noongar, and Kunwinjku ancestors must not be placed in an invented common family. Dreaming imperfectly translates diverse concepts and does not mean ancestry is wholly past. Exhibition or prior publication does not automatically authorize copying designs or retelling everything. Begin with materials Traditional Owners choose to share publicly.

Sumerian cities, temple traditions, hymns, and kingship.

长时段编纂，宗派与地方版本并存。

ui.aboutDesc: 这是一份探索的起点，而不是囊括所有传统的终点。
ui.aboutH1: 一张地图，不是整个世界
ui.aboutP1: 「神话星图」以五大洲、十九个阅读入口为起点，包括十八组神话与地方传统，以及单列的圣经叙事与基督教传统。每个体系均有人物独立档案、故事和世界观栏目。神话数量远超这一范围；国家、地理区域与神话体系也不总是一一对应。
ui.aboutP2: 这里的故事是便于入门的概述与改写，并非古代文献原文、学术定论或宗教教义。相同故事可能存在多个版本。我们区分古代文献、后世整理和仍在实践的信仰，不将各地文化简化为一套统一的“神明名单”。
ui.aboutP3: 许多传统仍与今天的社群、仪式和身份紧密相连。非洲、大洋洲和美洲均包含大量彼此独立的传统；本网站只提供有限案例，不呈现受限的神圣知识。原创插画是意象化设计，不是宗教器物或传统神圣图案的复刻。
ui.aboutP4: 建议从有注释的经典译本、博物馆与相关社群的公开资源继续阅读。以下为进一步探索的入口，并非对每一篇改写的逐句出处。
ui.aboutP5: 提供简体中文、繁體中文与 English。语言和星藏会保存在当前浏览器本地；不需要账号，也不会上传。切换语言后仍会停留在当前页面。
ui.aboutP6: 所有文明插画与天球图均为本站原创矢量绘制，页面无需图片服务即可显示。若希望安静阅读，可点击页脚“暂停动效”；网站也遵循系统的“减少动态效果”设置。

ui.transmissionDesc: 口述、写本、政治权力、宗教生活与现代改编，都可能参与流传。最早现存记录的年代，不等于一个故事首次被讲述的年代。
ui.worldCaution: 图中并列的是概念与叙事位置，不一定是物理分层，也不表示所有版本都认可同一套系统。

ui.methodTitle: 带着三个问题，继续阅读
ui.method1: 这份资料由谁、在何时、为谁写下或讲出？古代文本、殖民采录、现代儿童改写和实践者介绍，承担的任务并不一样。
ui.method2: 它属于哪个语言、地区或社群？相似名字不一定是同一位人物，同一故事也可能拥有并存而不必统一的版本。
ui.method3: 哪些是文本明确写出的内容，哪些是后来解释？承认不确定、比较注释与尊重公开知识边界，比记住一个过度整齐的答案更重要。
